note: Spring's sound world (doc 24, The four seasons): home key and nearby keys, the mode family, the tempo band (beats per minute, as recipes/music/realize.json counts beats), and the instrument palettes by slot and by weather. Each palette lists instruments for the melody and for the accompaniment, in order of preference; an instrument that is not built yet (harp, flute, kalimba) is skipped until it is. residents adds instruments when species have settled (doc 24, The score grows with the island).
